name: Oh My Pet
seoDescription: Explore Oh My Pet codes to unlock eggs, energy, potions, and rare items that boost your pet collection and gameplay in this Roblox pet simulator.
introMd: Oh My Pet is a Roblox game where you collect and hatch Eggs to get pets. You can also fuse pets to make stronger ones that earn coins even when offline. Using Oh My Pet codes gives you extra items like Eggs, energy, and potions to help you progress. These codes are a neat way to get free rewards without grinding too much.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Oh My Pet Codes
You don’t need to meet any special requirements to redeem codes. Just follow these simple steps.
1. [[roblox_link|Launch the Oh My Pet]] experience on Roblox.
2. Click the gift icon at the top-left corner of the screen.
3. Select the Codes option.
4. Enter the code exactly as it appears in the box.
5. Click Redeem to claim your rewards.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Redeeming codes in Oh My Pet usually grants you various useful items that help with pet collection and gameplay.

| Reward Type          | Description                                              |
|---------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| Uncommon Egg        | An egg that hatches into a pet with uncommon rarity.     |
| Chili               | A special item, likely used for pet boosts or events.   |
| Firework            | Consumable item, often used during celebrations.         |
| New Year Egg        | A themed egg available around New Year events.            |
| Candy Cane          | Event currency or item tied to Christmas events.          |
| Christmas Egg       | Seasonal egg with themed pets.                            |
| Energy              | Resource used to perform actions or speed up progress.   |
| Coins Potion        | Doubles the coins you earn for a limited time.           |
| Luck Potion         | Increases chance of rare pet drops temporarily.           |
| Tickets             | Currency used for special in-game events or shops.       |
| Relic               | Random special item with unique effects or value.         |
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes in Oh My Pet mostly release during game updates, so trying to redeem them immediately might fail until servers reset. To fix this, wait a bit after new codes drop before redeeming. Always copy and paste codes directly to avoid typos. Check your internet connection and rejoin the game if codes still don’t work.
